verdict.rationale: Graphite supports custom rules and comment exclusions for the AI review agent (graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-20), which covers per-repo instruction customization, but there is no evidence of a versioned config file checked into the repo, nor of path-based filters or multiple named review profiles selectable per path. missing for 10: evidence of a repo-committed/versioned config file format, path-level filtering rules, and support for multiple distinct review profiles.
